tasks-completed-rows.statement: Completed tasks on My Tasks show their task type and a Done date pill.

tasks-grouped-by-urgency.statement: Open tasks on My Tasks are grouped under Overdue, Due today, This week and Later, each row showing an icon for its task type and a coloured due-date pill.

tasks-summary-cards.statement: My Tasks opens with summary cards for open tasks, overdue (SLA breached), due this week and escalated to me; the Overdue card switches the list to overdue tasks only.
tasks-summary-cards.subject: my-tasks
